skirmish.module.food_hud.name: Food HUD
skirmish.module.food_hud.description: Hunger as a bar in the mod's style where the drumsticks were: gold is saturation, orange is hunger, red and pulsing at 6 or less (no sprinting). Hold food and what it would bring glows on the bar, with «+3 · +3,6» next to it. Food tooltips get the same line.
skirmish.module.food_hud.setting.saturat: How much saturation is left: gold on the bar or on the icons
skirmish.module.food_hud.setting.preview: While you hold food, what it would restore pulses on the bar
skirmish.module.food_hud.setting.label: Numbers
skirmish.module.food_hud.setting.label.t: "+3 · +3.6" right of the bar while you hold food
skirmish.module.food_hud.setting.tooltip: A hunger and saturation line in food tooltips
skirmish.module.food_hud.setting.style.t: Bar — hunger as a bar in the mod's style (gold is saturation, red and pulsing at 6 or less). Icons — vanilla drumsticks with the saturated ones tinted gold
